scores.doc: CDS 2025-2026 C9 blank: UC does not use SAT or ACT in admission

testPolicy.text: UC Berkeley, like every UC campus, does not consider SAT or ACT scores in admission decisions or in awarding Regents and Chancellor's scholarships; scores may be used for the statewide guarantee, minimum eligibility or course placement.
testPolicy.since: test-blind since fall 2023 entry for California applicants, extended to nonresidents (Regents decision of May 21, 2020; UC will not consider SAT or ACT scores in admission decisions or Regents and Chancellor's scholarships)

inState.totalIncludes: new students starting 2026-27, campus residence hall: tuition and fees 18,214 + housing 16,640 + meal plan 7,000 + Student Health Insurance Plan 5,066 = direct costs 46,920; total cost of attendance including personal expenses 54,674 (books, personal and transportation, 7,754, are not itemized on the page)

outOfState.totalIncludes: same budget plus Nonresident Supplemental Tuition 39,270 for new out-of-state students; 93,944 is 54,674 + 39,270 (sum computed, not printed)

aidPromise.text: Blue and Gold: most California families earning up to $100,000 receive enough grant and scholarship money to cover UC tuition. Tuition predictability: a UC student's tuition is set at first enrollment and stays the same for up to six years. Blue and Gold applies to California residents only.

deadlines.regular: November 30 (UC application filing period for fall 2027 entry, opens August 1)

facts.text: Berkeley received 126,864 first-year applications for fall 2025 and admitted 14,524; for fall 2026 it admitted 13,967 of 133,154 (preliminary), a 10.5% admit rate.
Of Berkeley's 13,967 fall 2026 first-year admits, 9,445 were Californians, 3,155 domestic nonresidents and 1,367 international students.
Berkeley offered 9,102 fall 2025 applicants a waiting-list place and 6,479 accepted, but it reported 0 admitted from the list (updated May 2026).
A new out-of-state student adds $39,270 of Nonresident Supplemental Tuition to Berkeley's $54,674 resident cost of attendance for 2026-27.
Tuition and fees for new 2026-27 students are $18,214, versus $17,560 for students who started in 2025-26, because UC fixes tuition by entering cohort.
UC guarantees first-year admission to a UC campus, though not necessarily the campus of choice, to California students in the top 9 percent of their high school or of the state.

notes: Berkeley publishes its CDS as Google Sheets (xlsx export saved in .cache-raw/cds/uc-berkeley_cds_2025-26.xlsx). C1 residency breakdown says 'State applicant data not yet available'. CDS G1 shows 2025-26 tuition 14,202 / nonresident 53,472, fees 4,262, food and housing 26,028 (headers say 2025-2026); cost uses the financial aid office's 2026-27 budgets, where tuition and fees are not split and books, personal and transportation are not itemized. Berkeley's Quick Facts page gives slightly different fall 2025 counts (third-party pointer, not used). Fall 2026 numbers are preliminary. No early plans; one UC application due November 30.
